b0413d732f1ef3d32be70fe03908dc3c22f713f1: A resort on a human scale, Belalp focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 38 km of runs are a perfect fit for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to keep changing their playground. Belalp's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for learning to ski with children. In terms of snow reliability, Belalp is in a strong position thanks to its highest point at 3118 m. Even during capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1322 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December. A stay in Belalp is clearly expensive: €78 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you need to be aware of it before you go. In short: Belalp doesn't compete with the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
